name: DNS Doctor
description: Scan, fix and verify a domain's DNS: email authentication (SPF, DMARC, DKIM), multi-region propagation, SPF include supply-chain audits, MX, DNS health, blacklists and domain/SSL expiry. Returns deterministic verdicts and copy-paste fix records generated by a validating engine — never a guessed record.

apiToken.description: DNS Doctor API token (dnsd_...) for the token-required monitoring reads. Falls back to the DNSDOCTOR_API_TOKEN environment variable.

apiBase.description: Base URL of the DNS Doctor API. Defaults to https://dnsdoctor.dev (falls back to the DNSDOCTOR_API_BASE environment variable).
